reason: The plugin integrates a configurable vision API with DeepSeek Harness so pasted or local images can be analyzed and represented as text for models that do not accept image input.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入可配置的视觉 API，使纯文本模型能够处理粘贴或本地图片并获得 OCR 或图像描述结果。
summaries.en: Connects a configurable vision API to DeepSeek Harness so text-only models can receive OCR or image descriptions from pasted or local images.

capabilities: Accepts pasted images in the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Sends images to a configured vision API for OCR or image description
Converts image analysis results into text for text-only models
Provides a see_image tool for images stored on disk
